item.title: List a Used Desk Lamp
item.audience: neighbours who might buy the lamp
item.prompt_text: You want to sell a small desk lamp in your building's notice group. It works, but there is a scratch on the base. You want $8. A buyer can see it working and collect it from the entrance on Saturday morning. Write the advert and say how to contact you.
item.target_grammar: Present simple for condition; but for a contrast; can for collection options.
item.target_structure: Name the item and price, describe its condition, and give a clear collection and contact instruction.

checklist.point: Describe the lamp and give the price.
Say that the lamp works and mention the scratch.
Offer a chance to see it working and say when and where to collect it.
Tell people how to contact you.
